attchmntText: Gayatri Projects Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Gayatri Projects Limited has informed the Exchange that it has been awarded a new project by Bengaluru Integrated Rail Infrastructure Development Enterprise Limited (B-RIDE) under a Joint Venture.

In continuation of our earlier disclosures, we wish to inform you that the Company has successfully repaid the entire outstanding fund-based borrowings availed from Banks and Financial Institutions in accordance with the agreed settlement terms, thereby fully discharging its payment obligations in respect of such facilities.Consequently, the Company is now debt-free in respect of fund-based borrowings from Banksand Financial Institutions, as on the date of this disclosure.
